verdict.why: kaikki-ru-en reads электронная почта as [ɪlʲɪkˈtronːəjə ˈpot͡ɕtə]; the model wrote /elʲɪkˈtro̟nʲɪvəjə ˈpotɕtə/

notes: Uncountable: refers to the email system, an email address, or mail collectively. For a single email message, use (электро́нное) письмо́ or име́йл.
Often shortened to просто по́чта in everyday speech (e.g., скинь мне на по́чту — 'send it to my email').

senses.definition: The system for sending and receiving messages over the internet, or a person's email account.

notes: Often shortened to 'почта' (mail) in casual office conversation.
Do not confuse with 'письмо' (letter), which usually refers to a physical paper letter or a specific message.

senses.definition: The system used to send and receive messages over the internet.

faults.why: Corrupt transcription for электронная; should be /ɪlʲɪkˈtronːəjə ˈpotɕtə/.

faults.quote: A specific message sent or received over the internet.
faults.why: Электронная почта is an uncountable system/collective noun; a single message is (электронное) письмо.

faults.quote: Мне пришла важная электронная почта от начальника.
faults.why: Unnatural Russian; natives say 'пришло важное письмо (по электронной почте)'.
